v11_sender_identity.description: ADT-002 regression check. A bundle command that omits its player argument must run as the caller. Establishes survival first so the log proves a transition rather than a final value. On a build carrying the defect this stops at the bare gamemode command and the DONE mark is absent.

v11_sender_identity_console.description: Run this from the server console, not from chat. A command needing a player must still be refused when there is no player, exactly as if typed at the console. Proves the correction restored sender identity rather than blanket-granting a player to everything.

v11_sender_identity_control.description: Control for v11. The same command with an explicit selector must succeed on every build, defect present or not. Distinguishes a broken bare-argument path from a broken command, a non-operator caller, or broken bundle execution.
